pokedexEntries.bk: The special membrane enveloping Alomomola has the ability to heal wounds.

pokedexEntries.wh: Floating in the open sea is how they live. When they find a wounded Pokémon, they embrace it and bring it to shore.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: It gently holds injured and weak Pokémon in its fins. Its special membrane heals their wounds.

pokedexEntries.su: It uses its special mucus to close the wounds of injured Pokémon. The reason for this behavior remains unknown.

pokedexEntries.mo: They float upon the open sea. Many water Pokémon gather in the area around Alomomola.

pokedexEntries.us: Fishermen take them along on long voyages, because if you have an Alomomola with you, there’ll be no need for a doctor or medicine.

pokedexEntries.um: The reason it helps Pokémon in a weakened condition is that any Pokémon coming after them may also attack Alomomola.
